ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 60% low-intensity (black/dark grey) central core and 40% high-intensity (white/mottled) distal lateral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity (black) region originating from the peduncle and extending to the median notch. Symmetrical but irregular high-intensity (white) fields on the lateral distal surfaces of both lobes. Right lobe exhibits higher density of grey-scale transition mottling compared to the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated internal angle approximately 68 degrees with a moderate depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency micro-serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel amplitude varies between 2-8 pixels with increased irregularity near the fluke tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave proximal sweep from the peduncle transitioning into a broad convex curve along the distal trailing margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-intensity circular pixel nodes (barnacle attachment sites) concentrated at the terminal tips of both lobes; sparse punctate white spots distributed across the central black field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, near-vertical high-contrast linear disruption (white rake mark) located on the right lobe, approximately midway between the notch and the fluke tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable vertical linear scar on the right lobe; extensive irregular depigmentation/scarring along the trailing edge margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular trailing edge topography with significant jaggedness at the distal-most points of both flukes.
